meta.name: lean-ux-canvas
meta.description: Guide teams through Lean UX Canvas v2. Use when framing a business problem, surfacing assumptions, and defining what to learn next.

copy.tagline: 用 Lean UX Canvas 引导团队梳理业务问题与假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要带领团队厘清产品方向并明确下一步要学什么
copy.tagline_en: Guide teams through Lean UX Canvas to frame problems and assumptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead teams in product innovation and want to clarify learning priorities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导团队按顺序填写 Lean UX Canvas v2 的 8 个框，帮助聚焦业务问题、梳理假设、定义实验和学习目标。
howto.when: 当用户提及需要框架化业务问题、梳理假设或规划学习目标时触发，例如要求运行 Lean UX Canvas 工作坊。

say.text: 帮我用 Lean UX Canvas 梳理 onboarding 流失问题。
say.note: Claude 会引导填写 canvas 的 8 个框。

say.text: 我想用 Lean UX Canvas 框架化一个 AI 产品创意。
say.note: Claude 会收集上下文后逐步提问。

say.text: 我们有业务问题但太多假设，请运行 Lean UX Canvas 环节。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude guides teams step-by-step through the 8 boxes of Lean UX Canvas v2, helping frame the business problem, surface assumptions, and define learning goals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention framing a business problem, surfacing assumptions, or planning learning goals, e.g., asking to run a Lean UX Canvas workshop.

say_en.text: Help me use Lean UX Canvas for onboarding drop-off.
say_en.note: Claude will guide through the 8-box canvas.

say_en.text: I want to frame an AI product idea with Lean UX Canvas.
say_en.note: Claude will gather context then ask questions.

say_en.text: We have a business problem but too many assumptions. Run a Lean UX Canvas session.
